name: Browser Vision
description: Lets agents browse websites through screenshots with an adjustable click grid.

command.name: bv
command.usage: bv open <url> | bv view [--density N] [--grid on|off] [--grid-color auto|#rrggbb] [--grid-opacity 0-1] [--focus <a>-<b>] | bv window phone|tablet|desktop|widescreen|<W>x<H> | bv click <n> | bv type [--enter] (text in body) | bv key <Key or combo> | bv scroll up|down | bv back | bv status | bv close
command.help:
Browse a website by looking at screenshots. Every screenshot is overlaid
with a grid, and every grid cell shows its number in its top-left corner.
Click numbers always refer to the most recent screenshot.

Subcommands:
  bv open <url>             open a page (a bare host gets https://)
  bv view [flags]           take a new screenshot
      --density N           grid cell size in px (default 40; smaller = finer)
      --grid on|off         show or hide the grid
      --grid-color auto|#rrggbb   line colour (auto picks contrast per segment)
      --grid-opacity 0-1    grid strength
      --focus <a>-<b>       zoom into the box between cells a and b
  bv window <preset|WxH>    phone, tablet, desktop, widescreen, or e.g. 1024x768
  bv click <n>              click the centre of cell n
  bv type [--enter]         type the body text into the focused field
  bv key <Key or combo>     press a key, e.g. Enter, Tab, Control+A, F5
  bv scroll up|down         scroll most of a screen
  bv back                   go back one page
  bv status                 url, title, window, grid settings, downloads
  bv close                  close your browser session

Examples:
  bv open example.com
  bv click 247
  bv view --density 10 --focus 245-290
  bv type --enter           with body: search words
  bv key Control+A

Downloads land in /me/downloads/ and can be read or edited with the normal CLI.
